data_policy: local files only; zero market-data API calls

periods.confirmation_rule: only after every candidate-specific development gate passes; otherwise not evaluated

costs.fee_note: fixed research assumptions from the repo, not a historical time-varying regulatory-fee schedule

benchmark: Yahoo split/dividend-adjusted SPY: first development open to final close; dividends already incorporated; identical whole calendar and initial capital; charge ETF buy/sell slippage and exit regulatory fees
calendar: exchange_calendars XNYS, regular days only for eligibility; all XNYS sessions retained in equity paths, including missing-data/no-trade dates

economic_gates.controls: actual mean daily net return must exceed every frozen control
economic_gates.intraday_drawdown_note: daily equity-path drawdown understates intraday extremes; no operational promotion without intraday mark-to-market audit

inference.bootstrap: paired monthly blocks for V83; paired five-session moving blocks for V84/V85/V86; report-date clusters for V87

v83.signal: prior-close stock/bond 60/40 weight drift since prior month-end; overweight -> SPXU; underweight -> UPRO
controls: same rule on scheduled sessions 10,11,12 of month
unconditional UPRO same eligible month-end dates

v84.rule: higher bid recovery both blocks -> UPRO; higher ask recovery both blocks -> SPXU; otherwise cash
v84.order: original per-symbol feed order, nondecreasing ts_recv, exchange sequence diagnostic for ties
v84.valid_quote: positive finite noncrossed bid/ask and positive sizes
v84.stability: split episodes by alternating 10-second episode-start bins within each block; same minimum 20 episodes per side; require 70% identical actions on primary active dates for BOTH subsets
controls: time-weighted depth imbalance through same interval
unconditional UPRO on actual active dates

v85.universe: all non-SPY symbols present in frozen v77 opening panel and local Alpaca daily files; no outcome-ranked selection
v85.network: five highest strictly positive Pearson correlations of stock-minus-SPY daily returns over last60 completed sessions before first session each month; min50 paired observations; ticker alphabetical tie break
v85.reporters: SEC8-K/8-K-A containing exact Item2.02; accepted after prior session close and strictly before current09:30; deduplicate issuer/day; all feature information available by10:30
v85.peer_exclusion: any peer with Item2.02 since prior session close and through10:30
v85.residuals: issuer09:30-10:00 stock return minusSPY; peer09:30-10:30 stock return minusSPY
v85.eligible_issuer: all five frozen peers have valid opening bars and no known own filing; positive correlations not available -> omit issuer
v85.signal: median issuer-minus-median-peer residual gap across issuers whose gap sign equals nonzero issuer residual sign
controls: fixed degree-preserving ticker permutation of monthly graph, seed8392
unconditional UPRO on actual active dates
v85.v73_reference: reconstructed median first-hour issuer-minus-SPY residual from the same locally available eligible reporters; same-date noncash agreement

v86.signal: actual archived16:00UTC funding<0 on XNYS session; record assumed public by16:30 under documented settlement mechanism
v86.delay_note: 30-minute delay stress because only30-minute spot bars exist; do not fabricate16:35 price
controls: same negative-funding rule on next XNYS session with same clock
v86.execution: bar open at entry and exit with30bps round-trip costs; no observed spot BBO; optimistic bar boundary replaced with explicit adverse slippage

v87.available: report Tuesday+7 calendar days; exclude all trading dates2023-02-03 through2023-03-27 inclusive to avoid ION delayed releases; source https://www.cftc.gov/MarketReports/CommitmentsofTraders/HistoricalSpecialAnnouncements/index.htm
v87.signal: long contracts/long trader count minus short contracts/short trader count; positive plus negativeES09:30open-09:59close ->SPXU; negative plus positiveES move ->UPRO
v87.es_contract: require one instrument id through formation interval; no stitching different contracts
controls: same adverse-open interaction with plain net position
unconditional UPRO on actual active dates

blocked.v91: issuer buyback authorizations/policies and execution history absent

fail_policy: failed blind gates stop before P&L; failed economic gates leave confirmation locked; no parameter search or repair
